# The Local Delivery Blog | Brisqq

> > Insights on last-mile delivery, omnichannel retail strategy, and customer experience optimization for modern retailers.

Brisqq's blog explores the intersection of retail logistics, delivery technology, and customer experience. Articles cover crowdsourced delivery solutions, omnichannel strategies, and how retailers can compete using same-day fulfillment and personalized service.

## Key Topics

- Last-mile delivery
- Omnichannel retail
- Same-day delivery
- Customer experience
- Retail logistics
- Brick-and-mortar stores
- E-commerce logistics
- Crowdsourced delivery
- BOPIS (Buy Online Pick-up In Store)
- Courier services
- Retail technology
- Big data in retail
- Cart abandonment
- Urban delivery
- Value-added services

## Last-Mile Delivery & Logistics

- [Converting Abandoned Carts Into Sales: The Secret Lies In Last Mile Delivery](https://blog.brisqq.com/converting-abandoned-carts-with-last-mile-delivery): Last-mile delivery strategies to reduce cart abandonment using Brisqq
- [How Urban Delivery is Disrupting the Logistics Industry](https://blog.brisqq.com/how-urban-delivery-is-disrupting-the-logistics-industry): Urban delivery disruption using stores as local warehouses for same-day
- [How small businesses can get ahead with crowdsourced logistics-as-a-service](https://blog.brisqq.com/taking-on-the-giants-how-small-businesses-can-get-ahead-with-crowdsourced-logistics-as-a-service): Crowdsourced logistics solutions like Brisqq for small business delivery
- [Five poor customer delivery experiences (and how they can be avoided)](https://blog.brisqq.com/five-poor-customer-delivery-experiences): Identifies common delivery problems and solutions for third-party providers
- [Choosing The Right Delivery Service For Your Business](https://blog.brisqq.com/choosing-the-right-delivery-service-for-your-business): Guide to selecting courier services for peak period delivery demands

## Omnichannel & Retail Strategy

- [The Evolution of the Consumer: Omnichannel vs. Multichannel Retail Strategies](https://blog.brisqq.com/omnichannel-vs-multichannel): Defines omnichannel vs multichannel retail strategy differences
- [This Flaw in E-Commerce Delivery Gives Brick-and-Mortar Retailers an Edge During the Holidays](https://blog.brisqq.com/brick-and-mortar-retailers-holiday-edge): How instant delivery gives physical stores advantage over UPS/FedEx hubs
- [From Data to Action: How Big Data is Redefining Retail Strategy](https://blog.brisqq.com/from-data-to-action-how-big-data-is-redefining-retail-strategy): Big data and IoT applications in retail strategy per McKinsey insights
- [6 Surprising Ways to Increase Sales in Retail](https://blog.brisqq.com/6-surprising-ways-to-increase-sales-in-retail): Tactics to boost in-store conversion and optimize retail sales performance

## Customer Experience & Personalization

- [How Retailers Can Craft the Ultimate Personalised Shopping Experience in their Retail Stores](https://blog.brisqq.com/personalised-shopping-experience): In-store personalization strategies including BOPIS at Nordstrom stores
- [10 Shocking Customer Service Statistics You Need to Know](https://blog.brisqq.com/10-customer-service-facts): Key customer service stats from American Express, Gartner for retailers
- [How You Can Improve Customer Experience Through Value-Added Service](https://blog.brisqq.com/improve-customer-experience-through-added-service): Value-added services like RFID smart mirrors and endless aisle at Ulta Beauty
- ['That Personal Touch': Personalising the Brand Experience](https://blog.brisqq.com/that-personal-touch-personalising-the-brand-experience): Retail personalization trends beyond Zara's mass-produced fashion approach

## Retail Technology & Innovation

- [Blockchain in Supply Chain Management - The Next Big Thing?](https://blog.brisqq.com/blockchain-in-supply-chain-management): Explores blockchain applications in supply chain with BiTA, UPS examples
- [A Creativity Crisis and the Luxury Fashion Landscape](https://blog.brisqq.com/a-creativity-crisis-and-the-luxury-fashion-landscape): Analyzes luxury fashion adaptation challenges with LVMH, Calvin Klein insights
- [Is Influencer Marketing the Ultimate PR Tool?](https://blog.brisqq.com/influencer-marketing-the-ultimate-pr-tool): Examines influencer marketing vs celebrity endorsements on Instagram/YouTube
